Ticket Id: 16460

01/06/2014

Dr Charles White
Thyroid Specialist
Bayview Private Hospital
81 Canyon Road
Bayview

Dear Dr White,

Re: Ms Lola Duval,    aged 24 years old

I am writing this letter to refer you Ms Duval, a 24-year-old engineering student, who complains of
unexpected weight loss in the last two months. Your earliest review would be highly appreciated.

On 31/05/2014, Ms Duval attended my surgery complaining of tremors, episodic palpitations, sweating,
heat intolerance in the last two – months as well as fatigue in the last month. Moreover, she was anxious
and concerned about her weight lost. Upon examination, her weight was 55 kg and she had slightly              Commented [JG1]: loss
enlarged thyroid gland without tenderness. In addition, her eyes had lid lag associated with some             Commented [JG2]: a
exophthalmos. Thus, some investigations were ordered. Please note, she has a medical history of anxiety
and insomnia for which she has been taking sleeping pills occasionally.

Today, Ms Duval test results came in showing sinus tachycardia in her ECG and her thyroid function test
showed that TSH level is less than 0.05 as well as elevation in free T3 by 15 pmol/L and free T4 by 40        Commented [JG3]: was
pmol/L. Therefore, a thyroid scan and thyroid auto-antibody tests were ordered.

In light of the above, my provisional diagnosis is hyperthyroidism. I would be grateful if you could assess
and review her condition as soon as possible as the patient is anxious. If you have any queries, please do
not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
